title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to author and run playbooks could view…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permission to author and run playbooks can access action data beyond their authorized scope and modify the status and message of other playbook runs. This occurs due to insufficient authorization checks in the playbook API.
